title: Spice | Charming Seaside Retreat | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Spice is a charming Seaside carriage house for up to four guests, just steps from the beach with private access, a balcony, and walkable dining.
description_expanded: Summer Special! Exclusive offer for arrivals May 23 - August 8, 2026 when you use code SUGARSPICE10 at checkout. Spice Features - Less than 100 yards to the Tupelo Beach Access - private Seaside beach access included with your reservation - 3 Blocks to Seaside commercial district with food trucks, shopping, and dining options - 2 Blocks to Seaside Adult Pool , Seaside Family Pool, and Seaside Fitness Center. Access included with your reservation - 3 Blocks to Seaside Tennis Center and Croquet Lawn - 534 Square Feet Carriage House Apartment - 2nd Floor Living area with loveseat and SmartTV - Full Kitchen including microwave with convection cooking feature - Dining area with seating for 4 - also doubles as a workspace - Private balcony with seating for 2 - Outdoor Shower available - 1st Floor Laundry closet with washer and dryer - WIFI and Cable with SmartTVs - Neighborhood parking for 1 vehicle on a first come, first serve basis - Area summer camps and kids classes available - Strict no pet property due to owner allergies. Bringing an unauthorized pet will incur extra cleaning charges and possible eviction. - Access to private Seaside Beach gates, community pools, and Seaside Fitness included with your reservation. Seaside Pools heated in cooler months (subject to change by the HOA) - Golf cart rentals restricted in Seaside per the HOA (Medical exceptions may be granted on a limited basis) - Concierge services including beach chair setup, grocery delivery, baby equipment rentals, and bike rentals available - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Welcome to Spice. It's gettin' hot in here! This is the perfect spot for enjoying some quality time together. Perfectly appointed for up to 4 guests, this carriage house is fully equipped for all you may need on your Seaside vacation including a full kitchen and laundry closet. Enjoy this detached carriage house with a private entrance and private gate to the Seaside walking trails. Combined with a premier location in Seaside, this beautiful cottage is calling your name. Enter through the Queen suite for a comfortable and restful sleep. The first floor also features a full bath and the private laundry closet. The second floor includes your living area, dining area, and full kitchen. The dining table is also great to use as a workspace when needed, and the home includes WIFI and cable. There is even a private balcony to enjoy time al fresco. Located 100 yards to the Tupelo Beach Access and 3 blocks to the center of Seaside with plenty of dining and shopping options. You are also only 2 blocks to the Seaside Adult Pool! This home is wonderful for honeymoons or weekend getaways. "Spice" has a sister main house (1896 Sq. Ft., 4 bedrooms, sleeps 14) on the property called "Sugar". The cottages are available for rent separately or together, and there is a good chance there will be a guest in the main house during your stay. The video tour on this listing includes a tour of both the main house and carriage house. Only the carriage house will be available for your stay.
